purpose: Stage concept review only; not runtime asset or real-time render
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new review concept image for BugWorld, a PICO immersive spatial app. This is DESIGN CONCEPT ART, not a screenshot or an already built scene. Landscape 16:9, a single immersive first-person eye-height view, no collage.
Reference 1 is the approved real Blender garden render: preserve the vocabulary, recognizable green lotus leaf shapes/veins, pink lotus flowers, weathered natural wood and small child-crayon-colored insects. Reference 2 is the current headset screenshot only as a diagnosis of problems: remove ALL its red annotations and rectangular control panel; do not inherit its black sky, overcrowded reeds, leaf/wood intersections, flat lighting, or striped purple water.
New design: an intimate 360-degree ring-shaped lotus pond around a clear central viewing position, shown looking forward from its center. Do not depict a person/avatar or a giant landscape vista. Keep existing object scale, but use far fewer objects and much less depth: several reachable large lotus leaves within arm reach, a small low fallen log off to the left properly resting in shallow water, one modest rooted stump to the back left, small clusters of reeds at the outer edge instead of a solid wall. Show enough open space between distinct small plant groups to see around the garden. A similar small garden should continue behind the viewer, not all front-facing theatrical scenery. No platforms or new buildings.
Lighting priority: readable, comfortably bright blue-purple starry twilight, lavender-blue horizon, soft silver-blue cloud wisps and many delicate pinprick stars. Sky occupies approximately the upper 40% and is visibly luminous, never black. A light subtle Milky Way haze is allowed, no enormous neon galaxy or oversaturated aurora. Bright diffuse skylight makes green leaves, brown wood, pastel crayon insect colors readable, with soft contact shadows and gentle warm pink light from lotus blossoms. No crushed shadows, no pure black leaf undersides. Restrained tiny fireflies, no heavy bloom or godrays.
Water: calm translucent dark teal-blue shallow pond, soft broad sky reflection, restrained tiny ripples near stems, natural readable water, no glitter metal surface, no striped neon purple texture. Wood and lotus leaves have clear physical separation and never intersect. Leaves have real volume, non-plastic material.
Interactions subtly shown: a small warm pearl-lavender return magic orb about 8 cm in diameter, floating low at the viewer's front-left beside a leaf, away from the insects, a simple fine outline of a paintbrush inside the orb; a tiny near-orb pill label in Chinese “回到画板” only, no large rectangular menu. Not a sun or large glaring sphere. One nearby crayon-patterned butterfly on a leaf with a fine, restrained pale-cyan silhouette rim indicating gaze focus; preserve the painted wing colors, do not turn the whole insect luminous. A small pastel ladybug rests on a separate leaf with no outline. Maximum two or three visible insects. No hand unless needed; prefer no hands.
Composition is soothing, polished, grounded, feasible mobile-XR art direction using texture-based sky and simple localized interactions, not an impossible high-end volumetric render. Add discreet small editorial corner text at top-left “BugWorld · 明亮星夜荷塘” and beneath it “概念设计 · 非真机画面”. No other text, no frame.

Edit this BugWorld concept art non-destructively into revision 2. Preserve the luminous blue-violet starry sky, readable green leaves, crayon butterfly and ladybug, delicate soft lighting, calm natural teal water, and all existing Chinese text. Preserve the “概念设计 · 非真机画面” label.
Correct the layout: the user asked for a SMALLER ring garden, NOT a densely populated lake extending into the distance. Remove ALL of the repeated tiny distant lotus leaves/stems and distant reed rows receding toward the center horizon. Beyond the few immediate plant groups there should only be water, a very faint low distant silhouette baked into a sky panorama, and the glowing sky. On the left and right, keep only one modest cluster of reeds each, with visible gaps, not walls of dozens of grass blades. Keep just 6–8 large near/mid lotus leaves visible total (preserve the butterfly and ladybug leaves), plus three pink lotus flowers. Preserve object sizes, reduce number and occupied depth instead of shrinking the plants. Keep the rooted stump and low fallen log, with no intersections with leaves. The close plants surround an open viewing pocket rather than blocking the face. The total detailed physical garden is only a few meters across; this is an art direction image, not an infinite corridor.
Shrink the return orb by roughly 25% and reduce its glow so it is a quiet utility object rather than the main focal point, retain the paintbrush icon and small “回到画板” label. The butterfly gaze outline should remain a thin pale cyan silhouette rim, not a thick neon stroke; no other insect is highlighted.
No additional UI, objects, characters, text, or futuristic effects. Maintain a polished yet feasible native mobile spatial app visual target.
